name: deployment-config-runtime
goal: Runtime dependencies resolve in bundled Node and external preview execution

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: PR 15 introduced a deep JSONC ESM import that Node cannot resolve; the managed web preview returns 500 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for impl/format.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing deployment-config boundary test bundles every dependency, hiding external package entry resolution. Extend its matrix to both bundled and external JSONC under Node.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 775ea77b reproduces the actual impl/format resolution failure with the installed package found; bundled mode passes and external mode fails under Node. Earlier 3ae3496c had an incorrect NODE_PATH and is setup failure, not defect proof.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use the supported public JSONC entry. Keep the existing boundary test matrix in normal verification and require bundled plus external execution when server code is shared with the preview.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: b77e749f uses the public package entry for Node; 82a8e5d9 resolves only JSONC to its ESM entry during desktop bundling. The boundary matrix uses actual shared build options.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 82a8e5d9 passes the same unchanged boundary matrix recorded failing at acd89b73, in the same environment. Both bundled and external Node modes parse JSONC successfully.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: An isolated snapshot of 82a8e5d9 fails the unchanged four-case matrix when the original private ESM import is reintroduced (impl/format), then passes all four cases after restoring the public entry. Logs preserved outside Git.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
